item.title: "If Jang Continues Disciplinary Politics, We Won't Stand Idly By": Faction Signals Strong Response (“張 징계정치 계속땐 좌시하지 않을 것” 소장파, 강력대응 예고)
item.description:
"If Jang Continues Disciplinary Politics, We Won't Stand Idly By": Faction Signals Strong Response (“張 징계정치 계속땐 좌시하지 않을 것” 소장파, 강력대응 예고)

Conflict within the People Power Party is escalating as the Central Ethics Committee (chaired by Yoon Min-woo, a professor at Gachon University) begins reviewing whether to discipline dozens of lawmakers. (국민의힘 중앙윤리위원회(위원장 윤민우 가천대 교수)가 의원 수십 명에 대한 징계 여부 검토에 착수하자 당내 갈등이 고조하고 있다.)

The "Alternatives and Future" group, a gathering of non-mainstream first- and second-term lawmakers, stated after a breakfast meeting on the 7th that they "will not stand idly by if Representative Jang Dong-hyuk continues disciplinary politics." The group has been at odds with Representative Jang, demanding his resignation. Some of its members are reportedly among those for whom disciplinary requests have been submitted to the Ethics Committee. (비주류 초·재선 중심 의원 모임인 ‘대안과 미래’는 7일 조찬 회동을 한 뒤 “장동혁 대표가 징계 정치를 계속하면 좌시하지 않겠다”는 입장을 밝혔다. 대안과 미래는 장 대표의 사퇴를 요구하면서 장 대표 측과 대립해 왔다. 소속 의원 일부는 윤리위에 징계 요구서가 제출된 것으로 알려졌다.)

The Ethics Committee is also reviewing whether to discipline pro-Han Dong-hoon lawmakers who supported independent candidate Han Dong-hoon in the by-election for Buk-gu, Busan, labeling them as "anti-party actors." The pro-Han faction has reacted strongly, calling it "political retaliation by Representative Jang." (윤리위는 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에서 무소속 한동훈 의원을 지원한 친한계 의원을 ‘해당 행위자’로 보고 징계할지도 검토 중이다. 친한계는 “장 대표의 정치적 보복”이라고 반발하고 있다.)

Not only from Representative Jang's side but also among mainstream lawmakers, many argue that "supporting an independent candidate over the party's own candidate is a clear 'anti-party act,' making discipline unavoidable." Representative Jang has consistently emphasized strengthening party discipline. Pro-power Supreme Council member Jo Gwang-han told reporters on the same day, "Is it wrong to hold someone accountable for a serious and clear anti-party act?" (장 대표 측뿐 아니라 주류 의원 가운데는 “국민의힘 후보를 두고 무소속 후보를 도운 건 ‘해당 행위’가 명백하니, 징계는 불가피하다”는 의견도 적지 않다. 장 대표는 당의 기강 세우기를 강조해 왔다. 당권파인 조광한 최고위원은 이날 기자들과 만나 “중대하고 명백한 해당 행위에 대해 책임을 묻는 것이 잘못이냐”고 했다.)

Floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik met with reporters and took a cautious stance, saying, "The decision to initiate disciplinary proceedings, as well as the targets, scope, and severity of the discipline, should be at a level that satisfies many party members, our lawmakers, and the public." A lawmaker from the metropolitan area suggested, "Regarding supporting an independent candidate over the party's own candidate, the leadership should conclude it as an 'anti-party act' and leave a record, but hold off on actual discipline to minimize factional conflict." (정점식 원내대표는 이날 기자들과 만나 “징계 절차 개시 여부와 징계 대상·범위·수위가 많은 당원과 우리 의원들과 국민이 수긍할 수 있는 정도가 돼야 한다”며 신중론을 폈다. 수도권의 한 의원은 “자당 후보를 두고 무소속 후보를 지원한 부분에 대해서는 ‘해당 행위’로 결론을 내리고 기록으로 남기되, 지도부가 징계는 보류하는 방식으로 계파 갈등을 최소화했으면 좋겠다”고 했다.)

On the same day, mutual criticism among People Power Party lawmakers over the disciplinary actions continued. Lawmaker Cho Kyung-tae (Saha-eul, Busan) was referred to the Ethics Committee after arguing that "a pro-insurrection force should not become vice speaker" during the process of electing the National Assembly vice speaker, opposing fellow party member Park Deok-heum's candidacy. Defending his actions on SBS Radio, Cho criticized the disciplinary attempt. Vice Speaker Park Deok-heum posted on Facebook, targeting Cho, saying, "If you don't want to follow the party's values and decisions, leave the party." (이날 국민의힘에선 징계를 놓고 의원들 간 비난도 이어졌다. 조경태(부산 사하을) 의원은 국회부의장 선출 과정에서 여당 의원에게 “내란 옹호 세력이 부의장에 앉아선 안 된다”며 같은 당 박덕흠 부의장 낙선을 주장해 윤리위에 제소됐다. 조 의원은 이날 SBS 라디오에서 본인 행동을 정당하다고 하면서 징계 시도를 비난했다. 박덕흠 부의장은 페이스북에 조 의원을 겨냥해 “당의 가치와 결정에 따르기 싫다면 당을 떠나라”고 했다.)

item.title: Will 2.47 Million Ballots from Jamsil Be Opened? Rival Parties Moving Toward Recount Agreement (잠실 247만장 투표함 여나… 여야, 재검표 합의 수순)
item.description:
Will 2.47 Million Ballots from Jamsil Be Opened? Rival Parties Moving Toward Recount Agreement (잠실 247만장 투표함 여나… 여야, 재검표 합의 수순)

A recount is expected for 2.47 million ballots from the local elections stored at the Olympic Handball Stadium in Songpa-gu, Seoul. Citizens protesting the ballot shortage have been holding rallies in front of the stadium, which served as a counting site, for over a month. (서울 송파구 올림픽공원 핸드볼경기장에 보관 중인 지방선거 투표용지 247만장에 대해 재검표가 이뤄질 전망이다. 투표용지 부족 사태에 항의하는 시민들은 개표소로 쓰였던 경기장 앞에서 한 달 넘게 집회를 하고 있다.)

Han Byeong-do, the acting leader and floor leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, stated at a party strategy meeting held at the National Assembly on the 7th, "We will actively review the recount plan proposed by the special parliamentary committee for investigation." Kim Seong-hoe, the party's floor spokesperson, told reporters, "We are open to a recount if necessary." (한병도 더불어민주당 대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 7일 국회에서 열린 원내대책회의에서 “국조특위에서 추진하는 (재검표) 방안을 적극 검토할 것”이라고 밝혔다. 민주당 김성회 원내대변인은 기자들과 만나 “재검표가 필요하면 하자는 입장”이라고 했다.)

Yoon Sang-hyun, a lawmaker from the People Power Party and chair of the special committee for the parliamentary investigation into the ballot shortage, has requested both parties to recount the ballots stored at the handball stadium. The National Election Commission (NEC) previously reported to the committee a plan to publicly recount the ballots at the stadium and then move them to the NEC headquarters in Gwacheon, Gyeonggi. The NEC stated that with a budget of 50 million won and 440 personnel, the recount would take nine hours. Kang Dong-wan, acting secretary-general of the NEC, said at the committee meeting, "If the National Assembly passes a resolution, we will proceed with the public recount immediately." <<> Around 380 ballot boxes, totaling 2.47 million ballots, and 104 voting records are currently stored at the handball stadium, which was used as a counting site for the June 3 local elections in Songpa-gu, Seoul. Following the ballot shortage, protests outside the stadium have prevented their removal for over a month. <<> Committee chair Yoon Sang-hyun said at the special committee meeting, "The recount is a way to resolve distrust in the NEC, especially as a minimal measure to embrace citizens outside the stadium calling for protection of their voting rights." A political source noted, "If we first confirm whether there were errors in the Songpa-gu election and counting process, it could offer a clue to resolving the prolonged protests." <<> However, some in the opposition are cautious about the recount. Lee Jun-seok, a lawmaker from the Reform Party and a member of the special committee, said, "Integrity can be verified to some extent by checking the sealed condition of the ballots. If we proceed with a political recount, those alleging fraud might question why it was done." <<> The special committee conducted on-site inspections at the NEC headquarters in Gwacheon and the Seoul Metropolitan Election Commission in Jongno-gu, Seoul, on the same day. It was confirmed that the Seoul Songpa-gu Election Commission first recognized the ballot shortage at 11:34 a.m. on the 3rd of last month, but the report reached Wi Cheol-hwan, then a standing NEC commissioner (now acting NEC chair), only at 6:10 p.m. Joo Jin-woo, a People Power Party lawmaker, said, "There was chaos due to a lack of ballots, and Acting Chair Wi was only briefed after the voting had already concluded." <<> Lee Ki-heon, a Democratic Party lawmaker, said, "The NEC situation room first noticed the ballot shortage at 4:25 p.m., but it wasn't until 50 minutes later at 5:08 p.m. that they realized the severity after confirming with the Seoul Election Commission. The lax work of the election situation room escalated the issue." <<> While the rival parties broadly agreed on the recount, they disagreed on the selection of witnesses for the special committee hearings scheduled for the 14th and 22nd. The People Power Party insists on summoning Kang Hoon-sik, chief of the presidential secretary office, and Minister of the Interior and Safety Yoon Ho-jung as witnesses, while the Democratic Party opposes this, stating, "The NEC is a constitutional body separate from the government." <<> Seo Beom-su, a People Power Party lawmaker, said, "The Democratic Party is limiting the parliamentary investigation to the NEC and maintaining a hands-off stance toward the presidential office, which is the control tower for all areas of South Korea." Shin Dong-uk, another lawmaker, added, "Since it could provide clues to uncovering the situation, we should summon the chief secretary and the interior minister." In response, Yoon Geon-young, a Democratic Party lawmaker, said, "Calling the presidential chief secretary is excessive by any measure." Jeon Yong-gi, from the same party, said, "I cannot understand the inclusion of the government to turn it into political strife." <<> The rival parties have selected a total of 97 witnesses for the first hearing on the 14th, including former and current NEC commissioners, Acting National Police Agency Commissioner Yoo Jae-seong, and Kim Tae-hoon, head of the joint police-prosecutor investigation unit. The special committee plans to decide on adopting a final report after holding two hearings. (투표용지 부족 사태 국회 국정조사 특별위원회 위원장인 국민의힘 윤상현 의원은 여야에 핸드볼경기장 내 보관 중인 투표용지 재검표를 요청했다. 중앙선관위는 앞서 국조특위에 경기장에서 공개적으로 재검표한 후 투표용지를 경기 과천 중앙선관위 청사로 옮기는 방안을 보고했다. 선관위는 5000만원을 부담해 인력 440명을 투입하면 재검표에 9시간이 걸릴 것이라고 밝혔다. 강동완 중앙선관위 사무총장 직무대리는 이날 특위 회의에서 “국회가 의결해 주면 곧바로 공개 재검표를 하겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Democrats also cautious about supplementary investigation power… Hong Ki-won of ruling party says "Concerns for harm to the weak, need deliberation" (민주당서도 보완수사권 신중론…與 홍기원 “약자 피해 우려, 숙의해야”)
item.description:
Democrats also cautious about supplementary investigation power… Hong Ki-won of ruling party says "Concerns for harm to the weak, need deliberation" (민주당서도 보완수사권 신중론…與 홍기원 “약자 피해 우려, 숙의해야”)

<<>> Voices of concern have emerged from within the Democratic Party of Korea, which has adopted as party policy the complete abolition of the prosecutor's supplementary investigation power without exception. Democratic Party lawmaker Hong Ki-won pointed out on the 8th that deliberation is necessary regarding the abolition of supplementary investigation power, citing the potential harm to socially vulnerable groups such as citizens and victims of sexual crimes. ()

On his Facebook page that day, Rep. Hong stated, "While eliminating the possibility of prosecutors' abuse of power and ensuring that political prosecutors never emerge again, we must undergo an in-depth deliberation process to consider whether there is room to retain a level of supplementary investigation power that minimizes harm to powerless and unjustly suffering victims." (예외 없는 검찰의 보완수사권 폐지를 당론으로 하는 더불어민주당 내부에서도 우려의 목소리가 나왔다. 홍기원 더불어민주당 의원이 8일 보완수사권 폐지와 관련, 숙의가 필요하다고 지적했다. 시민, 성범죄 피해자 등 사회적 약자들이 피해를 볼 수 있다는 이유에서다.)

Rep. Hong added, "Yesterday (the 7th), Acting Party Leader and Floor Leader Han Byung-do stated that 'the complete abolition of supplementary investigation power is unequivocal.' I recall that during the party caucus last March when discussing the laws on the Corruption Investigation Office and the Public Prosecution Service, several lawmakers raised the need for an exceptional retention of supplementary investigation power to protect powerless victims and to counterbalance the judicial police, who would monopolize investigative authority, and it was concluded that this would be discussed in earnest during future revisions of the Criminal Procedure Act." (홍 의원은 이날 자신의 페이스북에 “검사의 권한 남용 가능성을 없애고 정치검사가 다시는 나올 수 없도록 하면서도 힘없는 억울한 피해자를 최소화하는 수준의 보완수사권을 남겨둘 여지는 없는지, 심도 있는 숙의 절차를 거쳐야 한다”고 했다.)

He further said, "While opposing the retention of investigative power with potential for abuse by prosecutors, 'abolishing the investigative power of prosecutors' is not an end in itself but a reform to protect powerless victims and eradicate political prosecutors through this measure." (홍 의원은 “어제(7일) 한병도 당대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표께서 ‘보완수사권 완전 폐지는 확고부동’하다고 말씀하셨다”면서 “지난 3월 의총에서 공소청·중수청 법을 논의할 때 힘없는 피해자 보호 및 수사권을 독점하게 될 사법경찰관 견제를 위해 보완수사권의 예외적 존치 필요성을 제기한 의원들이 여럿 있었고 향후 형사소송법 개정 때 본격 논의키로 결론 낸 것으로 기억하고 있다”고 했다.)

He added, "With the establishment of the Public Prosecution Service and the Corruption Investigation Office, over 90% of prosecutors' investigative authority will be eliminated. In particular, arbitrary initiation of investigations and investigations into unrelated cases—which were typical abuses of prosecutorial power—have become impossible." He also emphasized, "The deliberation should not be one that presupposes a conclusion but rather one aimed at finding the optimal solution." (또 “검사에게 ‘남용 가능성이 있는 수사권 존치에 반대한다”면서도 “검수완박은 그 자체가 목적이 아니라 이를 통해 힘없는 피해자를 보호하고, 정치검사를 척결하기 위한 개혁”이라고 했다.)

On this day, the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee is set to deliberate the Criminal Procedure Act, which includes the complete abolition of supplementary investigation power. The People Power Party is likely to boycott the meeting in protest of the unilateral election of the committee chair. (그러면서 “중수청·공소청 설치로 검사의 수사권은 90% 이상 없어진다. 특히 검찰권 남용의 대표적 폐해였던 임의적 수사 개시, 별건 수사는 불가능하게 됐다”고 했다. 또 “결론을 정해놓고 하는 숙의가 아닌 최적의 해법을 찾아가기 위한 숙의가 되어야 할 것”이라고 강조했다.)

item.title: Rep. Koh Min-jung Declares Candidacy for Party Leadership "Will Build a Young Democratic Party, Succeeding Moon Jae-in and Supporting Lee Jae-myung" (고민정 당대표 출마 선언 “젊은 민주당, 문재인 계승·이재명 뒷받침 민주당 만들겠다”)
item.description:
Rep. Koh Min-jung Declares Candidacy for Party Leadership "Will Build a Young Democratic Party, Succeeding Moon Jae-in and Supporting Lee Jae-myung" (고민정 당대표 출마 선언 “젊은 민주당, 문재인 계승·이재명 뒷받침 민주당 만들겠다”)

Rep. Koh Min-jung of the Democratic Party of Korea officially declared her candidacy for the party leadership election at the August 17 National Convention on the 8th. (더불어민주당 고민정 의원이 8일 8·17 전당대회 당대표 선거 출마를 공식 선언했다.)

At a press conference held at the National Assembly Communication Hall that morning, Rep. Koh stated, "I will create a path for a young Democratic Party that listens to the voices of youth externally and nurtures youth internally." She added, "I will work to ensure the Democratic Party becomes a 'party for everyone' that represents the interests of the majority of the people and improves their lives one by one." She further noted, "I will take the lead in creating a Democratic Party that inherits the achievements of Moon Jae-in, which have been undermined by the Yoon Suk-yeol government, and supports the success of a Lee Jae-myung administration." (고 의원은 이날 오전 국회 소통관에서 출마 기자회견을 하고 “밖으로는 청년의 목소리를 듣고, 안으로는 청년을 키우는 젊은 민주당의 길을 만들어 내겠다”고 했다. “민주당이 국민 다수의 이해를 대변하고 국민의 삶을 하나씩 개선해 나가는 ‘모두의 민주당’이 될 수 있도록 하겠다”고도 했다. 그러면서 “윤석열 정부에서 훼손한 문재인의 성과를 계승하고, 이재명 정부의 성공을 뒷받침하는 민주당을 만드는 데 앞장서겠다”고 했다.)

Rep. Koh emphasized, "The Democratic Party, as the ruling party responsible for the people's lives alongside a Lee Jae-myung administration, bears an endless responsibility for the daily lives of the people and the future of the Republic of Korea." (고 의원은 “민주당은 이재명 정부와 함께 국민의 삶을 책임져야 하는 집권 여당으로, 국민의 일상과 대한민국의 미래에 대한 무한 책임이 우리의 어깨 위에 있다”고 했다.)

Rep. Koh remarked, "However, in the recent local elections, public sentiment dealt a harsh blow to the Democratic Party. In particular, the youth in their 20s and 30s completely turned their backs on us." She criticized, "To them, the Democratic Party was seen as 'a vested interest group that created and ignored disparities,' 'a hypocritical force that climbed the ladder of social mobility and then kicked it away,' and 'a faction that focused on issues far removed from people's lives, repeating internal conflicts while neglecting to care for the public.'" (고 의원은 “그런데 지난 지방선거에서 민심은 민주당에 회초리를 드셨다”며 “특히 2030 청년 세대는 민주당을 철저하게 외면했다”고 했다. 이어 “그들에게 민주당은 ‘격차를 만들고 방치한 기득권 세력’ ‘계층 이동 사다리를 오른 뒤 걷어차 버린 위선적 세력’ ‘국민의 생활과는 거리가 먼 이슈로 우리 안의 갈등을 반복하며 국민의 삶을 돌보는 데는 부족한 세력’이었다”고 비판했다.)

Rep. Koh stressed, "Our Democratic Party must start anew by acknowledging this. Faced with the warning of public sentiment, we must intensely reflect on what we lacked and seek alternatives." (고 의원은 “이것을 인정하는 것에서 우리 민주당이 다시 시작해야 한다”며 “민심의 경고 앞에 우리가 부족했던 것이 무엇인지 치열하게 성찰하고 대안을 모색하는 것이 지금 우리가 해야 할 일”이라고 강조했다.)

Regarding internal party strife, Rep. Koh said, "If we remain mired in power struggles and repeat worthless debates unrelated to people's lives, winning general elections or regaining power will become difficult. We must set aside branding and derogatory language, recognize one another, communicate, and find alternatives." (고 의원은 당 내분과 관련해 “우리가 권력 투쟁에 매몰돼 국민 삶과 아무 관련도 없는 무가치한 논쟁을 반복한다면 총선 승리도, 정권 재창출도 어려워질 것”이라며 “낙인 찍기와 멸칭의 언어를 거두고, 상대를 인정하고 소통하며 대안을 찾아 나가야 한다”고 했다.)

Rep. Koh pledged that if elected party leader, she would introduce a 'youth quota system' allocating a certain percentage of party positions in the central and regional chapters to young people, and a 'party member deliberation committee' for thorough discussion in major policy decisions. She also proposed establishing a 'Youth Future Committee' directly under the party leader, with its chairperson being the youth deputy leader of the central party, to create a process for direct communication and discussion with the party leader. (고 의원은 당대표가 되면 중앙당과 시·도당 당직 일정 비율을 청년에게 주는 ‘청년 당직 할당제’와 당의 주요 정책 결정 과정에서 숙의를 거치는 ‘당원공론화위원회’를 도입하겠다고 했다. 또 당대표 직속으로 ‘청년미래위원회’를 두고, 위원장은 중앙당 청년부대표로 해 당대표와 직접 소통하고 논의하는 절차를 만들겠다고 했다.)

With Rep. Koh's candidacy, the Democratic Party leadership election will become a four-way race, including former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, who previously declared his candidacy, former leader Song Young-gil, who announced his candidacy on the same day, and former leader Jeong Cheong-rae, who is expected to seek re-election. (고 의원의 출마로 민주당 당대표 선거는 앞서 출마를 선언한 김민석 전 국무총리와 이날 출마를 선언하는 송영길 전 대표, 연임 도전이 전망되는 정청래 전 대표까지 4파전으로 치러진다.)

Rep. Koh is the only female candidate in her 40s among the four contenders. She was previously elected as a Supreme Council member in the party convention held in August 2022. <<>> (고 의원은 후보 4인 가운데 유일한 40대 여성 주자다. 2022년 8월 전당대회에서 최고위원 선거에 출마해 당선된 바 있다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok Takes Another Direct Aim at Chung Cheong-rae: "Overzealousness Ruined the Merger with the Innovation Party" (김민석, 정청래 또 직격…“과욕에 혁신당과 합당 그르쳐”)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok Takes Another Direct Aim at Chung Cheong-rae: "Overzealousness Ruined the Merger with the Innovation Party" (김민석, 정청래 또 직격…“과욕에 혁신당과 합당 그르쳐” )

Kim Min-seok, a former Prime Minister who has declared his candidacy for the leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea, appeared on Kim Eo-joon's YouTube channel on the 8th to clarify suspicions regarding his absence from the vote to lift martial law on December 3rd. (더불어민주당 대표 출마를 선언한 김민석 전 국무총리가 8일 김어준씨 유튜브에 출연해 12·3 계엄 당일 계엄 해제 투표 불참에 대한 의혹을 해명했다.)

On that day, Kim Eo-joon released CCTV footage showing the situation at the National Assembly on the day of the martial law declaration, during his show "Humility is Hard. News Factory." Kim explained, "As far as we know, he didn't just keep sleeping after taking cold medicine; he woke up late, was already inside the National Assembly by climbing over the wall by the time of the vote, and missed it by a narrow margin." (김어준씨는 이날 자신이 진행하는 ‘겸손은 힘들다. 뉴스공장’에서 계엄 당일 국회 상황을 녹화한 CCTV 영상을 공개했다. 그러면서 김씨는 “저희가 알기로는 감기약 먹고 계속 잔 게 아니라 뒤늦게 일어났고, 표결 시점에는 이미 국회 담을 넘어 국회 안에 있었고, 간발의 차이로 놓쳤다”며 설명했다.)

In response, former Prime Minister Kim stated, "I was one second late (to the vote)," adding, "The moment I sat down, Lee Jae-myung, who was then the party leader next to me, said, 'I just pressed (the button).'" (그러자 김 전 총리도 “(표결에) 1초 늦었다”며 “(본회의장에) 딱 앉는 순간 제 옆자리에 계시던 이재명, 당시 대표께서 ‘막 눌렀다’고 했다”고 했다.)

Regarding the merger with the Fatherland Innovation Party, former Prime Minister Kim said, "That's something the Innovation Party must decide," and added, "When forces of a similar nature unite with the Democratic Party, a large responsible party, it's always through absorption mergers." (조국혁신당과의 합당 문제에 대해 김 전 총리는 “그건 혁신당이 결정해야 한다”며 “거대 책임 정당인 민주당으로 성격이 같은 세력들이 결합할 때는 다 흡수 합당한다”고 했다.)

Criticizing former Representative Chung's approach to pushing the merger, he pointed out, "He ruined it by making a surprise announcement," adding, "It was overzealous. (As a result) I think things got tangled up." (정 전 대표의 합당 추진 방식에 대해서는 “폭탄선언식으로 해서 일을 그르쳤다”며 “과욕이었다. (그래서) 일이 꼬였다고 본다”고 지적했다.)

In response to former Representative Chung Cheong-rae's criticism that "the party leadership being a romantic aspiration is just him playing politics," former Prime Minister Kim said, "If that's the only example you can point to, then I'm grateful for the evaluation that I've hardly engaged in self-serving politics." (김 전 총리는 정청래 전 대표가 ‘당 대표가 로망이라고 한 게 자기 정치’라며 자신을 비판한 데 대해선 “그것이 지적할 수 있는 유일한 사례라면 저는 자기 정치를 거의 안 했다고 평가해주신 것이어서 감사하다”고 했다.)

Former Prime Minister Kim also revealed that he once recommended writer Yoo Si-min, who has recently been clashing with him, for the position of Prime Minister. Kim said, "I never once considered becoming Prime Minister myself," adding, "When someone asked, 'Have you ever recommended writer Yoo Si-min (as Prime Minister)?' I replied, 'That's correct.'" (김 전 총리는 최근 자신에 대해 대립각을 세우고 있는 유시민 작가를 총리로 추천한 적이 있다는 점도 밝혔다. 김 전 총리는 “원래 총리를 하려고 생각한 적이 한 번도 없다”며 “누가 ‘혹시 유시민 작가를 (총리로) 추천한 적이 있느냐’고 하셔서 ‘맞습니다’라고 말씀드렸던 적도 있다”고 했다.)

Regarding the 2016 general election under the Kim Jong-in emergency committee system, where former Prime Minister Lee Hae-chan, former Representative Chung Cheong-rae, and lawmaker Kim Hyun were cut off, he said, "I was so angry that I went to the National Assembly and met with lawmaker Kim Hyun," adding, "I once publicly said that it would be good for former Representative Chung to become party leader at some point." (또 ‘김종인 비상대책위’ 체제로 총선을 치른 2016년 이해찬 전 총리, 정청래 전 대표, 김현 의원 등이 컷오프된 점에 “너무 화가 나서 국회 앞으로 찾아가서 김현 의원을 만난 적이 있다”며 “언젠가는 정 전 대표가 한 번 당 대표를 하는 게 좋겠다는 이야길 공개적으로 한 적도 있다”고 했다.)

However, he added, "But aside from that, since he (former Representative Chung) has already held the (leadership) position once..." (그러면서도 “그런데 그것과 달리 (정 전 대표는) 한번 (대표직을) 하셨으니까”라고 덧붙였다.)

item.title: Opposition party’s decision on ‘preference voting’ for party leader... Pro-Chung faction protests, “Must withdraw immediately” (與 당대표 ‘선호 투표’ 결정에...친청계 반발 “당장 철회해야”)
item.description:
Opposition party’s decision on ‘preference voting’ for party leader... Pro-Chung faction protests, “Must withdraw immediately” (與 당대표 ‘선호 투표’ 결정에...친청계 반발 “당장 철회해야” )

In relation to the Democratic Party of Korea’s decision to adopt preference voting for the party leader election at the August 17 national convention, dissenting voices have emerged within the party. (더불어민주당이 8·17 전당대회에서 선출하는 당 대표 투표 방식을 선호도 투표로 하기로 결정한 것과 관련, 당 내부에서 반대 목소리가 나왔다.)

At the Supreme Council meeting on the 8th, Supreme Council member Lee Seong-yoon stated, “This is a clear violation of the party constitution and regulations, making it invalid,” adding, “While preference voting may be feasible for elections like floor leader or speaker elections, it is an unsuitable method for the party leader election, which involves a tour-based voting system.” (8일 최고위원회의에서 이성윤 최고위원은 “명백한 당헌·당규 위반으로 무효”라며 “실무적으로 선호투표 방법은 원내대표나 의장 선거 같은 선거에는 가능할 수 있지만 순회투표를 하는 당대표 선거에는 맞지 않는 방식”이라고 했다.)

Supreme Council member Moon Jeong-bok also said, “Introducing preference voting for the party leader election was supposed to be discussed again after the open Supreme Council meeting ends,” and added, “Changing the rules by amending the party constitution and regulations does not seem right.” (문정복 최고위원도 “당대표 선출에 선호투표를 도입하는 것은 공개 최고위가 끝나고 다시 논의하기로 했다”며 “당헌·당규를 개정하면서까지 룰을 바꾸는 것은 옳지 않은 것 같다”고 했다.)

The previous day, the party’s election preparatory committee announced that after discussing two methods, preference voting and runoff voting, they decided on preference voting. In this system, voters mark their first, second, and third preferred candidates on a single ballot. In the first tally, if a candidate secures a majority with first-preference votes alone, the winner is confirmed. If no candidate achieves a majority, a second tally includes second-preference votes, and if still no majority, a third tally includes third-preference votes. (전날 당 전당준비대회위원회는 선호투표와 결선투표 등 두 가지 방식을 논의한 결과 선호투표제로 결정했다고 밝혔다. 투표자가 1·2·3순위의 선호 후보를 한꺼번에 투표용지에 기입하고, 1차 집계에서 1순위 득표로만 과반을 얻은 후보가 나오면 당선자를 확정한다. 만약 과반 후보가 나오지 않을 경우 2차로 2순위까지 집계, 그래도 나오지 않으면 3차로 3순위까지 포함해 집계하는 방식이다.)

Some argue that this method favors pro-Lee Jae-myung candidates. This is because two out of the three early contenders for party leadership—former Representative Jeong Cheong-rae, former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, and lawmaker Song Young-gil (Kim and Song)—are pro-Lee. Regardless of whether the first preference is for a pro-Lee candidate or Jeong, the second preference is likely to go to the remaining pro-Lee candidate. (일각에서는 친명(친이재명) 후보에게 유리한 방식이라는 주장도 나온다. 일찍이 당권 주자로 거론된 정청래 전 대표, 김민석 전 총리, 송영길 의원 3명 중 2명(김·송)이 친명이기 때문이다. 1순위가 친명이든 정 전 대표이든, 2순위에는 남은 친명 후보를 쓸 가능성이 높기 때문이다.)

The previous day, former Representative Jeong Cheong-rae said, “I respect and accept the election committee’s decision.” (전날 정청래 전 대표는 “전준위 결정을 존중하고 수용한다”고 했다.)

On the same day, lawmaker Cho Seung-rae, who previously served as the party’s secretary-general, wrote on Facebook, “Introducing preference voting for the party leader election violates the party constitution and regulations,” and urged, “Either withdraw it, or if you intend to implement it, amend the party constitution and regulations.” (같은 날 당 사무총장을 맡았던 조승래 의원도 페이스북에 “당대표 선출에 선호 투표를 도입하는 것은 당헌·당규 위반”이라며 “철회하든지, 시행하려면 당헌·당규 개정을 해야 한다”고 밝혔다.)

Cho added, “Article 25, Clause 4 of the party constitution explicitly mandates the implementation of runoff voting. The party regulations, Rule No. 4 on Election of Party Officers, also stipulate that a candidate with a majority of votes shall be elected, and runoff voting shall be conducted for this purpose.” (조 의원은 “당헌 제25조 4호에는 결선투표 실시를 명기하고 있다. 당규 제4호 당직선출규정에도 과반수 득표자를 당선인으로 하고 이를 위한 결선투표 실시를 규정하고 있다”고 했다.)

He further stated, “To implement preference voting, the clause on runoff voting for electing the party leader in the party constitution must be removed, or the party regulations must clearly define preference voting as a form of runoff voting.” <<>> (그러면서 “선호투표를 실시하려면 당헌상 대표선출 결선투표 조항을 들어내거나, 당규상 선호투표를 결선투표의 한 방법이라고 분명하게 정리하든지 해야한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Lee Promotes K-Defense at NATO: "Let's Research, Produce, and Operate Weapons Systems Together" (李, 나토서 K방산 세일즈... “무기체계 함께 연구·생산·운용하자”)
item.description:
Lee Promotes K-Defense at NATO: "Let's Research, Produce, and Operate Weapons Systems Together" (李, 나토서 K방산 세일즈... “무기체계 함께 연구·생산·운용하자”)

<<> President Lee Jae-myung, visiting Ankara, Turkey, in line with the schedule of the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) summit, stated on the 7th (local time), "We must go beyond the current defense industry cooperation of trading weapons systems between (Korea and NATO) and elevate it to a 'Korea-NATO Defense Industry Partnership 2.0,' where we research, produce, and operate weapons systems together." <<> President Lee attended the 'NATO Defense Industry Forum' held in downtown Ankara on this day and delivered a keynote speech in the fourth session under the theme 'Shared Values, Stronger Industrial Base, Expanded Partnership and Cooperation.' He said, "The Republic of Korea would like to make several proposals to move toward a safer world together with NATO." <<> President Lee stated, "We must boldly expand joint research on advanced technologies," and expressed hope that "more joint research programs, like NATO's cooperation programs in ammunition and space sectors in which Korea participates, will be planned and promoted." He added, "Just as member countries of the International Energy Agency jointly manage strategic oil reserves to respond to energy crises together, I hope this wisdom will be applied in the defense industry as well." <<> President Lee particularly emphasized that the importance of defense industry cooperation is growing due to the current unstable international situation. He said, "Today, we are living in an era of uncertainty, beyond the stable period of the international order that has continued since the Cold War, where geopolitical conflicts have become常态 (constant)." He added, "In an era of uncertainty, actions must be bolder and cooperation must happen more quickly." <<> Furthermore, he diagnosed, "The military use of advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence, drones, and robots has become a key factor determining victory or defeat in war. Also, along with producing weapons, how robustly we maintain the global supply chain has become the essence of deterrence." He continued, "Wars are not decided only on the battlefield; research labs and industrial sites producing weapons have become the front lines of national security," and "In an era where the defense industrial base itself determines the survival of a nation, that is why we must discuss cooperation today." <<> President Lee remarked, "For cooperation to exert true power, trust is as essential as technology and production capacity. Cooperation cannot exist without the confidence that supply will not be cut off under any circumstances, and the belief that core technologies will be safely protected." He emphasized, "The Republic of Korea has the conditions for that trust," adding, "NATO and Korea share the memories of devastating wars and are partners that have together upheld the values of democracy, freedom, and peace in a severe security environment." <<> President Lee further stated, "Based on this trust, Korea's defense industry is maintaining close cooperation, beyond the Atlantic and Eurasia, with many NATO allies including Poland, Germany, France, Romania, and Norway," and reiterated, "Protecting democracy, freedom, and peace is not the responsibility of any one nation alone. The Republic of Korea will be the most reliable partner." <<> When asked by the moderator after the keynote speech what NATO should prioritize the most, President Lee responded, "In Europe, demand at the individual country level is not large, but if bundled together, demand can increase enormously. Ultimately, sustainable demand management must be done well. Also, standardizing (weapons system) norms between governments is important." ()

item.title: U.S. Embassy in Seoul: "Ambassador Steel to Arrive in Seoul Soon... Expectation of Strengthened Relations" (주한 美대사관 “스틸 대사 곧 서울 부임... 관계 강화 기대”)
item.description:
The U.S. Embassy in Seoul stated on X (formerly Twitter) on the 8th, "Introducing Michelle Steel, the new U.S. Ambassador to South Korea," adding, "Ambassador Steel will soon arrive in Seoul, and we look forward to further strengthening the relationship between the two countries." (주한 미국 대사관은 8일 X(옛 트위터)에 “미셸 스틸 신임 주한 미국 대사를 소개한다”며 “스틸 대사는 곧 서울에 부임할 예정이며, 양국의 관계를 더욱 강화해 나가기를 기대하고 있다”고 밝혔다.)

In the accompanying video, Ambassador Steel alternated between English and Korean, saying, "It is a great honor to be appointed as the next U.S. Ambassador to South Korea," and "I look forward to meeting all of you in person soon." (함께 올라온 동영상에 등장한 스틸 대사는 영어와 한국어를 번갈아 말하면서 “다음 주한 미국 대사로 부임하게 돼 매우 영광”이라며 “곧 여러분을 직접 만나 뵙기를 기대한다”고 했다.)

Ambassador Steel completed the confirmation process in the U.S. Senate on the 17th of last month and has also received the agrément (consent to the appointment) from the South Korean government, so she is expected to assume her post soon. (스틸 대사는 지난달 17일 미 상원의 인준 절차를 마쳤고 한국 정부의 아그레망(주재국 부임 동의)도 받아 조만간 부임할 것으로 예상된다.)

Ambassador Steel becomes the second Korean-American U.S. Ambassador to South Korea, following former Ambassador Sung Kim (served from 2011 to 2014) during the Obama administration. (스틸 대사는 오바마 행정부 시절 성 김 전 대사(2011∼2014년 재임) 이후 두 번째 한국계 주한 미국 대사가 된다.)

The position of U.S. Ambassador to South Korea had been vacant since former Ambassador Philip Goldberg, appointed under the Joe Biden administration, left his post in January of last year. The vacancy in the ambassadorship is resolved after about a year and six months. (주한 미국 대사직은 조 바이든 행정부에서 임명된 필립 골드버그 전 대사가 지난해 1월 이임한 후 비어 있었다. 대사직 공백은 약 1년 6개월 만에 해소된다.)

Born in Seoul in 1955, Steel comes from an immigrant family that moved to the U.S. in 1975. After serving as an elected member of the California State Board of Equalization and as an Orange County Supervisor (chief administrative officer), she served four years as a Republican member of the U.S. House of Representatives starting in 2021. (1955년 서울에서 태어난 스틸 후보자는 1975년 미국으로 이주한 이민자 가족 출신이다. 캘리포니아주 조세형평국 선출 위원, 오렌지카운티 수퍼바이저(행정책임자) 등을 역임한 뒤 지난 2021년부터 4년간 공화당 소속 연방 하원 의원을 지냈다.)

item.title: Chung Jin-suk Meets Justice Minister Chung Sung-ho, Stating "Supplemental Investigation Authority Must Be Preserved" (정점식, 정성호 법무장관 만나 “보완수사권 존치해야”)
item.description:
People Power Party Floor Leader Chung Jin-suk, during a meeting with Justice Minister Chung Sung-ho on the 8th, referenced the Jang Yoon-gi case, stating, "To wipe away the tears of the victims, the prosecution's supplemental investigation authority must be preserved." (국민의힘 정점식 원내대표가 8일 정성호 법무부장관을 접견한 자리에서 장윤기 사건을 언급하며 “피해자의 눈물을 닦아주기 위해 검찰 보완수사권을 존치해야 한다”고 했다.)

Floor Leader Chung met Minister Chung at the PPP floor leader's office in Yeouido, Seoul, that morning, saying, "Abolishing the prosecution's supplemental investigation authority would immediately lead to complete police control. It would mean a total monopoly of investigative power by the police." (정 원내대표는 이날 오전 서울 여의도 국민의힘 원내대표실에서 정 장관을 만나 “검찰 보완수사권 폐지는 곧 경수완독. 경찰의 수사권 완전 독점”이라며 이같이 말했다.)

Referring to Jang Yoon-gi's rape and murder case of a high school girl in Gwangju, Floor Leader Chung said, "The problem is that without the prosecution's supplemental investigation, there was a high likelihood that the truth of this case would have been permanently concealed." Police, who initially investigated the murder of a Gwangju high school girl on May 5, applied a simple murder charge to Jang Yoon-gi and sent the case to the prosecution just nine days later. However, the prosecution, upon receiving the case, conducted a supplemental investigation, uncovering that Jang's father, who was a police officer, had destroyed some evidence, and indicted Jang on charges of murder including rape, rather than simple murder. (정 원내대표는 장윤기의 광주 여고생 강간 살인 사건을 언급하며 “문제는 검찰의 보완 수사가 없었다면 이번 사건의 진상이 영원히 은폐됐을 가능성이 컸다는 점”이라고 했다. 지난 5월 5일 발생한 전남 광주 여고생 피살 사건을 처음 수사한 경찰은 장윤기에게 단순 살인 혐의를 적용해 9일 만에 검찰에 송치했다. 하지만 사건을 넘겨받은 검찰이 보완수사를 통해 경찰인 장의 부친이 일부 증거를 폐기한 사실 등을 밝혀내며 검찰은 단순 살인이 아닌 강간 등 살인 혐의로 기소했다.)

Floor Leader Chung pointed out that the discussion on abolishing the supplemental investigation authority is being degenerated into a tool for the Democratic Party of Korea's party convention. He said, "This issue should be thoroughly handled from the perspective of victims and the public, but it is becoming a subject of internal political strife aimed at the Democratic Party's convention. I want to ask whether the tears and grievances of victims and their families are invisible to the Lee Jae-myung government. Are the venting and stress relief of the party's hardline supporters more important?" (정 원내대표는 보완수사권 폐지 논의가 더불어민주당의 전당대회용으로 변질되고 있다는 점을 지적했다. 그는 “이 문제는 철저히 피해자와 국민의 관점에서 다뤄야 할 사건인데 다분히 민주당 전당대회를 겨냥한 당내 정쟁의 소재가 되고 있다”며 “이재명 정부에 피해자와 그 가족들의 눈물, 억울함은 보이지 않는 것인지 묻고 싶다. 당 강성 지지자들의 분풀이, 스트레스 해소가 먼저냐”고 했다.)

He added, "Wasn't the justification for prosecutorial reform supposed to be checking the omnipotent power of the prosecution? Then, now, you must present an alternative on how to respond to the police's monopoly over investigative power." (그러면서 “무소불위의 검찰권을 견제한다는 것이 검찰 개혁의 명분 아니었나. 그럼 이제는 경찰 수사권 독점에 어떻게 대응할 건지 대안을 내놔야 한다”고 했다.)

In response, Minister Chung said, "The government's basic stance is to abolish the supplemental investigation authority, but since the final authority lies with the National Assembly, I ask for thorough discussions." Minister Chung, who has argued for the necessity of the supplemental investigation authority, recently told reporters, "Even if the government has a stance, don't the lawmakers there say that legislative power lies with the National Assembly? Won't the distinguished lawmakers discuss it well?" (이에 정 장관은 “정부 입장은 보완수사권 폐지를 기본적 입장으로 하고 있지만 국회에 최종 권한이 있는 만큼 충분한 논의를 해주길 부탁드린다”고 했다. 보완수사권 필요성을 주장해 온 정 장관은 최근 기자들과 만나 “정부의 입장이 있다고 하더라도 저기 계신 분(민주당 의원)이 입법권은 국회에 있다고 말하지 않는가”라며 “훌륭하신 의원들이 잘 논의하지 않겠나”라고 했었다.)

That day, he also said, "Floor Leader Chung is also an outstanding legal professional. I earnestly ask him to actively participate in the Legislation and Judiciary Committee and convey various concerns." He added, "Regardless of the bill, the majority party might ultimately pass it through a vote as a last resort, but my personal belief is that before such a process, the ruling and opposition parties should meet and sufficiently consult and discuss. I ask the opposition party to actively participate in the Legislation and Judiciary Committee and vocally express public concerns and the alternatives proposed by the opposition party during such discussions." (그는 이날도 “(정) 원내대표도 훌륭한 법조인 출신인데 법사위에 꼭 참여해서 여러 우려 전달하길 간곡히 부탁드린다”고 했다. 그러면서 “어떤 법안이든 최후 수단으로 다수당이 표결로 의결할 수도 있겠지만 그런 과정이 있기까지는 여야가 만나서 충분히 협의하고 대화해야 한다는 게 개인적 소신”이라며 “야당에서 법사위에 적극 참여해서 그런 논의 과정에서 국민적 우려를, 야당이 제시한 대안들을 적극 말해주기를 부탁드린다”고 했다.)

After meeting with Floor Leader Chung for about ten minutes, Minister Chung met with reporters and said regarding the supplemental investigation authority, "I suggested that it would be good for the opposition party to actively voice their opinions and present alternatives during the legislative process in the National Assembly." (정 장관은 약 10여 분간 정 원내대표를 예방하고 난 뒤 기자들과 만나 보완수사권과 관련해 “국회 입법 과정에 야당도 적극적으로 목소리 내고 대안 제시하는 게 좋지 않겠냐는 말씀을 드렸다”고 했다.)

When asked if the government's stance had changed somewhat, he said, "Since the government concluded its stance on abolishing the supplemental investigation authority, the basic position is to adequately address any potential concerns and create a solid alternative. If there are expected issues from abolishing the supplemental investigation authority, we need to develop measures to address them, and it is important to establish institutional mechanisms to ensure that the demand for supplemental investigation is effective while preventing police from abusing their authority." (정부 입장이 다소 달라진 것 아니냐는 질문에는 “정부 입장이 보완수사권 폐지로 결론 났기 때문에, 나올 수 있는 우려 사항들을 충분히 보완해서 확실히 대안을 만들어줘야 한다는 게 기본 입장”이라며 “보완수사권 폐지했을 때 예상 가능한 문제점이 있다면 그런 점에 대한 보완책을 만들어줘야 하고, 보완 수사 요구가 실효성을 가질 수 있도록 또 경찰이 권한 남용하지 않도록 하는 제도적 장치를 만드는 게 중요하다”고 했다.)
